messages:
elaine_support: Morning team — quick daily from me. Yesterday: cleared 18 tickets (6 escalations). Current queue: 42 open (5 P1s, 12 P2s). Known issue: embeddings API (edge region) returning intermittent 500s, tracking at INC-5421. Macros: updated 'password-reset' and 'rate-limit' (see snippet below). Blockers: need someone to own after-hours rotation tonight (6pm-10pm PT).

sam_k: I can take tonight. Any repro steps for the embeddings errors?

elaine_support: awesome @sam_k, thanks. Repro steps: 1) send batch embeddings >100 items to eu-west-edge 2) observe 500s after ~30s. Logs show KV cache miss spikes and timeouts. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5421

priya_m: Added a temporary fallback in Support Console to route affected accounts to eu-central. Not ideal but it reduced customer errors in our test. Also added a note to the macros: 'If embeddings fail, route to eu-central and escalate to infra'.

benji: quick ping on CR #433 (macro docs) — can someone review? only a small wording change and new fallback instruction.

priya_m: reviewing now, will approve in ~15m.

triage-bot: Incident INC-5421 status changed to "Investigating" — assigned to @infra-oncall.

deploy-bot: Deployed macro update to prod (password-reset, rate-limit) — deploy ID dep-20260317-78.

sam_k: saw one alert about increased retry loops after the fallback. I set a temporary rate-limit override to 20r/s for heavy accounts to reduce churn.

elaine_support: action items: @sam_k on after-hours; @priya_m follow up with infra for mitigation plan and ETA; @benji merge CR once approved. I'll draft a short customer-facing note if impact grows. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

benji: merged and queued for next patch release.

elaine_support: FYI — macro snippet we pushed:
```
Name: embeddings_fallback
When: embeddings error code 500 from eu-west-edge
Action: route_request -> eu-central | add_comment "Routed due to edge errors"
Escalate: if >3 retries, tag infra and support-sg
```

sam_k: noted. keeping an eye on alerts, will post updates if anything changes.
